_note: Captured 2026-07-29 from REAL signed-in DOM, through the app's own WKWebViews (the only
signed-in surface on this device — Simulator Safari is signed out of all four platforms).
Every value here resolved on a live page. NONE has yet been verified by DRIVING it, which is a
different and stronger claim: resolution only proves an element matched, while driving proves the
element was the right one. Provenance says 'resolved', and it should not say 'driven' until a run
has acted on it and asserted the outcome.
The 17 absent keys are absent on purpose. Nine need a response on screen (sources,
response_container, activity_panel, artifact_panel, audio_ready_marker); five need an interaction
first (ChatGPT's send appears only once the composer is non-empty, and its research option lives
inside the composer-plus menu; NotebookLM's add_source and generate_audio live inside a notebook,
not on the notebook list); and Gemini's deep_research_toggle is a contract mismatch rather than a
missing value — see the note in bin/capture_selectors.py.
surface is ios-app-webview, not ios-mobile-safari: the app pins an iPhone Safari 17 user agent
while Simulator Safari reports 26.5, so the two surfaces are not proven to render the same DOM.
